segments.text: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
And his disciples asked him, saying,

segments.speaker: Disciples
segments.text: Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
Jesus answered,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
And said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (
which is by interpretation, Sent.)

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He went his way therefore,
and washed, and came seeing.
¶ The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said,

segments.speaker: Neighbours
segments.text: Is not this he that sat and begged?

heading: The Healing of the Blind Man

segments.text: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

segments.speaker: Neighbours
segments.text: Therefore said they unto him,
How were thine eyes opened?
He answered and said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
¶ They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight.

segments.speaker: The Pharisees also
segments.text: He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
Therefore said some of the Pharisees,

segments.speaker: Others
segments.text: This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day.
Others said,

segments.speaker: others
segments.text: How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles?
And there was a division among them.
They say unto the blind man again,

segments.speaker: Blind Man
segments.text: What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes?

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: He said,
He is a prophet.
But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
And they asked them, saying,

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
His parents answered them and said,

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
Therefore said his parents,

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: He is of age; ask him.
Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
He answered and said,

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Then said they to him again,
What did he to thee?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: how opened he thine eyes?
He answered them,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
Then they reviled him, and said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: The man answered and said unto them,
Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is,

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
They answered and said unto him,

segments.speaker: The man
segments.text: Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us?
And they cast him out.
Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And Jesus said unto him,
Thou hast both seen him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: and it is he that talketh with thee.

segments.speaker: Blind Man
segments.text: And he said, Lord, I believe.
And he worshipped him.
¶ And Jesus said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Are we blind also?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus said unto them,
If ye were blind,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
